full_judgment: 10. The pre-emptor Abdul Karim and his father Momin Biswas purchased five kathas i.e. 0.0825 Ajutangsha of land from CS Plot No. 968 in equal share by registered deed on 24-4-60 and thereafter on the death of his father the pre-emptor filed partition suit against the other heirs of his father in the court of Sub-Judge, 1st Court, Faridpur being TS No. 36 of 1975 and the said suit was decreed in preliminary form on 30-11-77 and thereafter an Advocate Commissioner was appointed for distributing and separating the boundary of the saham of the ejmali land to the parties of the said partition suit and the Advocate Commissioner. accordingly distributed and separated the saham and filed his statement on 2-10-78. Thereafter, the final decree was passed on 23-12-78 and the suit property fell in the saham of respondent Nos. 2, 3 and 4 and they possessed the property in their respective share in khas. Respondent Nos. 2-4 sold the suit property on 29-12-84 to the Appellant long after the final decree was passed in Title. Suit No. 36 of 1975 and thereafter the pre-emptor respondent No. 1 filed the pre-emption Miscellaneous Cases on 28-9-85 on the ground of co-sharership.
